mapper.select: select cr_rb_room.resource_id, cr_rb_room.template_id template, cr_rb_room.template_name, cr_rb_room.`NAME`, cr_rb_room.description, cr_rb_room.sub_type category, cr_rb_room.pre_skill, cr_rb_room.train_skill, cr_rb_room.start_time, cr_rb_room.end_time, cr_rb_room.difficulty difficult, cr_rb_room.create_user_id, cr_rb_room.create_time, cr_rb_room.enable_recording, cr_rb_room.support_partial_start, cr_rb_room.modify_user_id, cr_rb_room.local_scene_id, cr_rb_room.copyed_topo_id, cr_rb_room.training_status, cr_rb_room.logo, cr_rb_template.duration_time, local_scene.start_time scene_start_time, local_scene.end_time scene_end_time, local_scene.scene_status from cr_rb_room left join cr_rb_template on cr_rb_room.template_id = cr_rb_template.resource_id left join local_scene on cr_rb_room.resource_id = local_scene.business_instance_id where cr_rb_room.resource_id = #{resourceId}

select sum(case when training_status = #{completedStatus} then 1 else 0 end) as completed, sum(case when training_status = #{completedStatus} then 0 else 1 end) as uncompleted from cr_rb_room where resource_id in
#{roomId}
select name ,resource_id as hash from cr_rb_room where (training_status = ${PAUSE_STATUS_CODE} or training_status = ${RUNNING_STATUS_CODE} or training_status = ${RECOVERY_STATUS_CODE})
